svg.text: Interface connector (one per signal group; arrow = active to passive)

The selected VLSIT architecture uses a NEW sharer directory, transaction table, probe scheduler and CCU. OpenHW HPDcache is MODIFY in a separate license-preserving copy for MESI state and tagged probes; the pristine upstream clone remains unchanged. PULP Culsans is architecture reference only because its pinned PlanV cache ports do not match the selected OpenHW HPDcache. Status codes: REUSE = unchanged upstream RTL; REUSE* = candidate pending compatibility checks; MODIFY = source adaptation/wrapper; NEW = VLSIT RTL; GENERATED = CSR RTL from the reviewed workbook. The diagram is a document-grounded proposal, not an integrated RTL hierarchy.
At least two distinct-line transactions; exact capacities remain open.
Adapts each hart's cache request/response and tagged probe boundary; repeated once per active hart.
Tracks requester, line lock, unique active tag, holder mask, responses, dirty-data obligation and LLC completion for at least two distinct lines.

Issues tagged probes only to directory-selected holders and associates each response/data beat with its active transaction.
Separates non-cacheable device transactions from cacheable memory according to the SoC address/attribute contract.
Carries uncached device traffic to the external AXI4 fabric and returns responses without allocating cache lines.
AXI4 transaction channels; the SoC fabric decodes targets.
Physical line lookup, conservative holder bitmap, committed fill/downgrade/invalidation/eviction update, and transaction association.
